title: Universal Life Insurance Valuation Memorandum: Value Released on Full Surrender
content:
On the full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, the value the surrender releases is the amount from which the cash surrender value and the taxable amount are figured. It follows the days from the latest monthly anniversary in the deduction history (the monthly anniversary of the most recent monthly deduction entry) to the surrender's effective date.

## Valuation

- **15 days or more** (the full-carry days): the account value carried forward by interest on the part above the loan balance at the tier's current fixed account rate plus the persistency interest bonus, and by collateral interest on the loan balance at the credited rate of the policy's loan type, simple over 365.
- **1 to 14 days**: the account value carried forward by interest on the part above the loan balance at the tier's guaranteed minimum interest rate, simple over 365.
- **0 days** (the effective date is the monthly anniversary itself): the account value as shown.

The account value and loan balance are those on the policy record. The credited rate of the loan type is the preferred loan credited rate from the tier's preferred loan first policy year (policy year 11, or 6 on the Ashgrove Indexed UL Premier) and the standard loan credited rate before it, both 3% on every tier, the policy year being that of the surrender.

| Tier | Current fixed account rate | Guaranteed minimum interest rate |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL | 3.5% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Protection UL | 3.75% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Accumulation UL | 4.25% | 2% |
| Ashgrove Indexed UL Protect, Growth and Premier | 3.25% | 1% |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: Ashgrove Protection UL in policy year 8, persistency interest bonus 0.25%, account value $250000.00, loan balance $60000.00)

| Days from the latest monthly anniversary | Interest above the loan | Collateral interest | Value released |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | $190000.00 times 0.04 times 20 over 365, $416.4384 | $60000.00 times 0.03 times 20 over 365, $98.6301 | $250515.0685 |
| 10 | $190000.00 times 0.02 times 10 over 365, $104.1096 | none | $250104.1096 |
| 0 | none | none | $250000.00 |
